user_intent: Eliminate all ATS parsing failure modes (grid tables, non-ASCII en-dashes, day-of-month dates, non-standard headings) across the entire codebase while maintaining autonomous JD-tailored skill prioritization and updating all pre-existing candidate profile resumes without touching runtime output folders.
why_user_made_such_thinking: The user understands the critical divergence between LLM semantic comprehension and legacy ATS entity extraction. Workday, Taleo, and Textkernel employ coordinate-based text extractors (Poppler pdftotext / C++ regex engines) that flatten PDF streams by vertical baselines. Tables cause cross-column text interleaving, merging category labels into skill lists and dropping data. Furthermore, the user recognized that removing tables would break the existing pipe-split skill prioritization logic, demanding an architectural upgrade (Option B) that supports both ATS-safe single-column layouts and dynamic JD keyword boosting.
why_user_performed_this_way: The user acts as a rigorous Principal Systems Architect: he refuses surface-level 'AI is smart enough' assurances and demands empirical proof down to exact PDF coordinate streams and byte-level characters. He explicitly gates code modifications (Axiom 2: Developer Mode Gatekeeping), enforces strict data isolation (forbidding touching output/ directories), and mandates autonomous cognitive reflection through Sophron.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Firm and demanding of total architectural adherence: approved Option B upon receiving the empirical proof report, mandated universal migration across all profiles, and corrected the AI when Sophron autonomous reflection was skipped in earlier turns.
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes. The AI dissected the Playwright CDP PDF rendering pipeline, proved that python-markdown generated 4 <table> DOM structures, refactored tailor_summary_and_competencies() with regex ^(\s*\*\*[^*]+\*\*:?\s*)(.*) to sort JD-matched keywords without tables, verified Guardrail P1 purity, updated all candidate profiles, and connected the active transcript to Sophron.

evolutionary_takeaways: PDF tables are fatal to enterprise ATS field extractors: text extractors sort by vertical coordinate baselines, interleaving adjacent table columns into scrambled strings.
Single-column bold labels (**Category:** Skill 1, Skill 2) provide 100% linear text extraction fidelity while maintaining clean visual grouping for human recruiters.
Date ranges must strictly use Month YYYY - Month YYYY with ASCII hyphens (0x2D) to ensure regex matching in legacy ATS engines and eliminate CP1252 mojibake risks (â€“).

Resume tailoring engines must never rely on table pipe delimiters (|) for NLP skill prioritization; regex pattern matching on structured bold lines enables dynamic keyword boosting on single-column documents.
Guardrail P1 purity must be validated after any engine refactoring to guarantee zero candidate PII or folder paths are hardcoded in core/ scripts.

Sophron Cognitive Memory does not have an automatic OS-level hook in Antigravity; the agent must explicitly execute run_master_agent.py learn and maintain interaction_history reflection cards at every milestone.
